rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for undergoing hardship or suffering, including physical suffering when the focus is on what someone goes through rather than the sensation itself.

example.english: I've really had to suffer since losing my job.
example.jyutping: nei1 paai4 sat1 jip6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 sau6 fu2

rows.note: Use this when “suffer” specifically means experiencing physical pain.

example.english: I suffer pain when I get an injection.
example.jyutping: daa2 zam1 go2 zan6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 tung3

rows.note: Use this when someone endures or puts up with another person’s insults, behavior, or other unpleasant treatment.

example.english: I can't suffer him yelling at me every day.
example.traditional: 我忍受唔到佢日日鬧我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jan2 sau6 m4 dou2 keoi5 jat6 jat6 naau6 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when a situation, performance, or condition becomes worse, as in schoolwork suffering.

example.english: My schoolwork has started to suffer lately.
example.jyutping: ngo5 fan6 gung1 fo3 gan6 paai4 bin3 caa1 zo2
